title: Requesting Deadline Flexibility
description: You need to message a project teammate to request a one-day extension on your shared deliverable after an unexpected family obligation.
requiredElements: Key fact: unexpected family obligation affected your timeline
Emotion/intent: respectful accountability and desire to keep trust
Request/next step: ask for a one-day extension and propose a concrete catch-up plan

title: Addressing Group Chat Tension
description: You need to message a friend after a tense group chat exchange where your comment came across as dismissive.
requiredElements: Key fact: your comment in the group chat sounded dismissive
Emotion/intent: acknowledge impact and repair the relationship
Request/next step: ask to talk and clarify expectations going forward
